name: ReWound 101
source:
You play as Shaizee, a high school junior, who's main hobby is to study.

She was satisfied with her everyday self until one day she woke up learning that she might think otherwise.

[From [url=https://zhaieyuemn.itch.io/rewound-101]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演Shaizee，一名高中生，主要爱好是学习。

她对自己的日常生活感到满意，直到有一天她醒来发现自己可能有不同的想法。

[来自[url=https://zhaieyuemn.itch.io/rewound-101]Itch.io[/url]]
